author: St. Thomas More
name: The Apology of Sir Thomas More
name_pt: A Apologia de Sir Thomas More
desc: More's Apology of 1533, his defence of his own conduct and writings against the charges of the Saint-Germain and others, including his handling of heretics as Chancellor.
desc_pt: A Apologia de More (1533), defesa de sua conduta e de seus escritos, incluindo o trato dos herejes quando Chanceler.
edition: The apologye of syr Thomas More knyght (London: 1533), EEBO-TCP A07692.
